name: salamanders-breath-decline-second-banish-still-applies-power
notes: Salamander's Breath: the Diana Bonus On Attack lets player 2 banish up to X (2) fire cards from their graveyard for +1 POWER each. One is banished, the second offer is declined. The decline used to skip SalamandersBanish, so the +1 POWER for the banished card was lost.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Salamander's Breath's optional-choice continuation (SalamandersBanish) was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the prompt (PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods skip the handler and its follow-up never ran: the +1 POWER for the already banished card was lost. Fix: the queue site passes dontSkipOnPass and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
